\section{Continuous paragraph}
This paragraph is intentionally long so that it continues across a page break in
a single-column article. Layout recovery should emit continuation evidence for
semantic paragraph assembly rather than treating the fragments as unrelated
blocks. The same semantic paragraph identity should survive the page boundary
even when the visual blocks are split by pagination artifacts in the PDF.\@

The paragraph keeps going with additional synthetic academic prose about document
compilers, evidence pipelines, and reading-order graphs. Repetition is
deliberate: it inflates vertical extent without introducing new structural
elements. More lines follow to guarantee a second page in typical LuaLaTeX
output. Still more text ensures the break happens before any new section heading
appears, isolating the cross-page continuation case for benchmark evaluation.
